title: Types of Forces
ques: When you kick a football, are you using a **push** or a **pull** force?

answer.content: When you kick a football, you are using a **push** force to move the ball away from your foot.

explanation: This tests the basic understanding of force as a push or a pull.

title: Frictional Force
ques: If you roll a toy car on a smooth wooden floor and roll the same toy car on a thick, fluffy carpet, on which surface will the car stop sooner, and why?

answer.content: The car will stop sooner on the **fluffy carpet**. This is because the carpet creates more **friction**, which is a force that slows down moving objects when they rub against a surface.

explanation: This introduces friction through a relatable, practical scenario.

title: Gravitational Force
ques: Why does an apple fall down from a tree to the ground instead of floating up into the sky?

answer.content: The apple falls down because of **Gravity**. Gravity is an invisible pulling force that pulls everything towards the center of the Earth.

explanation: This explains gravity as a fundamental force acting on mass.
